title: An Overview of Perpetual Bonds
author: Unknown
content: Yale’s Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library has a bond issued by Dutch water authority Stichtse Rijnlanden in 1648, which still pays interest. Steady, predictable source of income with payments on a set schedule Some perpetual bonds increase interest at predetermined points in the future Investors are subject to perpetual credit risk exposure Issuers may be able to recall some perpetual bonds Rising general interest rates could diminish the value of the perpetual bond
